entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `@section` inside a tag helper element is silently dropped (SDK 11.0.100 regression) #86459
  • Unexpected error is reported for a delegate creation of off an extension block method #86458

Closed

  • CS8940 (ERR_WrongArityAsyncReturn) is only reported during emit but is not classified as a build-only diagnostic #86391
    Backlog
  • Razor formatting closes an element twice when its end tag is split across lines inside a code block #86396
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis* 5.12 nuget packages missing - .net 11 Release #86395
  • Hot Reload reports source generator errors from an old snapshot after the errors are fixed #86336
  • Missing diagnostics from a file containing only implementation part #86250
    18.14
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/main` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #86457

PullRequests

Created

  • Write unsupported ProjectData markers during opted-in builds #86463
  • Simplify names in target-typed conditional expressions #86462
    Community, VSCode
  • Revert "Update ICSharpCode.Decompiler to 11.2.0.10050" #86461
    VSCode
  • Fix premature constraint checking for extension-block delegate conversions #86460
  • Map old symbols to baseline #86453
    Needs API Review, VSCode

Merged

  • Classify CS8940 and CS8204 as build-only diagnostics #86404
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Better formatting of Html tags in Razor #86454
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Fix stale source generator diagnostics in Hot Reload #86378
    VSCode, Next
  • Partial members: avoid missing diagnostics from implementation-only semantic models #86324
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Discard root compilation events in CompilationWithAnalyzers #86347
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • [release/stable] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86455
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86456
    Next

Updated

  • Honor commit characters when expanding semantic snippets #86380
    Community
  • Stop scanning preceding siblings in SyntaxNavigator.GetNextToken/GetPreviousToken #86352
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Handle syntax wrappers in address-of data flow analysis #86446
    Area-Compilers
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3135596 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Razor duplicate using cleanup and diagnostic de-dupe #86424
    Area-Razor
  • Fix Razor component discovery when a base component falls back #86451
    Area-Razor
  • Remove the unsafe v2 stackalloc/SkipLocalsInit restriction #86294
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add tests for syntax wrappers in address-of data flow analysis #86445
    Area-Compilers, Test-Gap
  • Inline arrays: disallow capture with address-of #86325
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.11] Update FBA sources #86425
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3134809 #86164
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86370
